medianTimeToSharesSecs.reason: A fork has no network contention, so speed is only claimed from mainnet runs.

limitations: Every run so far is on a Surfpool fork of mainnet: balances come from cheatcodes, nothing appears on a mainnet explorer, and there is no congestion or competing flow.
Fork routes exclude proprietary AMMs whose quote state is updated off-chain on mainnet only, so fork fills can be slightly worse than mainnet fills.
On a fork there is no second RPC provider; Verified means the surfnet readback matches the event and each Pyth price matches Hermes history.
Speed is not claimed from a fork.
